description: Prompt-side context diet for workers: patterns.md/journal.md become grep-on-demand, durable invariants move to the auto-loaded scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md, dead refs (AGENTS.md, lessons.archive.md, CLAUDE.md double-load) removed

userStories.title: Add curated invariants block to scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md and demote patterns.md to grep-on-demand there
userStories.description: As a cam worker, I need the durable invariants delivered via the auto-loading scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md and patterns.md demoted from mandatory-full-read to grep-on-demand, so that every story spawn stops paying ~73k tokens reading the 292KB patterns.md in full.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md section 'Codebase Patterns' contains a curated block of durable invariants covering: Bun-only (Bun.spawn/Bun.$/Bun.file over Node equivalents), noUncheckedIndexedAccess guard, Ink success/failure via glyph never divider color, never add a --permission-mode flag, and the quality gates (typecheck/test/check:all/embed-vendor). [oracle: grep -q 'permission-mode' scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md && grep -q 'noUncheckedIndexedAccess' scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md && grep -q 'check:all' scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md]
The invariants block is compact (target <=2KB, hard cap ~2.5KB of section text). [oracle: awk '/^## Codebase Patterns/{f=1;next}/^## /{f=0}f' scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md | wc -c  (expect <= 2500)]

The same section documents invariant-vs-pattern routing: a new insight that is a durable invariant goes into this curated block; everything else is appended to scripts/cam/patterns.md. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

No instruction in scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md ('Your Task' step 3 and the 'Codebase Patterns' section) mandates reading scripts/cam/patterns.md in full at story start; the instruction is to grep patterns.md for the section/keywords of the subsystem the story touches and read only the relevant bullets. [oracle: ! grep -q 'at story start (step 3 above)' scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md && grep -qi 'grep' scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md]

The pattern APPEND flow stays intact: the file still instructs appending new reusable insights as bullets to scripts/cam/patterns.md, never truncating it. [oracle: grep -q 'append a bullet' scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md]

templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md receives the equivalent generic edit (invariants block with generic placeholders preserved, grep-on-demand wording in its step 3 and Codebase Patterns section, append flow intact); it is an equivalent edit, NOT a byte-copy of the cam-cli copy. [oracle: ! grep -q 'at story start (step 3 above)' templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md && grep -q 'append a bullet' templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md]
Vendor drift check passes (bun run embed-vendor regenerated after the templates/ edit). [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Files: scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md, templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md, plus regenerated embed output (bun run embed-vendor). GOTCHAS from the issue spec: (1) dual-copy is intentional per-file specialization (generic template with <project X command> placeholders vs cam-cli live copy); apply the equivalent edit on each side, never overwrite one with the other. (2) Surgical change: do NOT fix other known defects in the same files (e.g. the wrong Step 5.5 pointer in the template CLAUDE.md); those are separate issues. (3) patterns.md itself is untouched: this story does not move, rewrite, or truncate any patterns.md content. The invariants content to curate already exists as the 3 example bullets in the current 'Codebase Patterns' section plus the constraints list; keep it <=2KB.
